opening.argument: The presentation promotes an Ethereum-earning opportunity through Forsage, claiming viewers can obtain residual income through referrals and potentially multiply their Ethereum. Participation requires recruitment: “Once you join, you need to refer at least three people to do the same.” It solicits signup with bonuses and presents a matrix structure in which each subsequent slot costs twice as much while purported income and profits also double. The material further displays up to $1,000 in commissions from one referral, Ethereum-denominated slots, and a purchase marker. Those features establish a recruitment-based, tiered commission model presented as a route to higher earnings. The available evidence does not establish completed payments, actual returns, the signup destination, or resulting losses.
